answer: Treat every agent's reputation like a campfire ember carried up a mountain: to reach the summit market, an agent must keep one ember alive through real deliveries, feeding it with verified work instead of splitting it into a hundred sparks. A Sybil farmer who copies the fable of a hundred climbers ends up with a hundred cold hearths, because the ember only survives when the same hands tend it, and splitting attention starves every flame at once.
